integrity: Original copula construction, admissibility bounds, rank-correlation formula and sufficient TP2 result are attributed to earlier authors. Derived converse SI criterion and uniqueness statements are analytic; computed decimals are illustrative, not their proof.
limitations: Classification is restricted to the explicitly defined exponentiated FGM family, and exact Spearman bounds are not universal over all stochastically increasing copulas. Publication priority beyond inspected relevant primary material remains independently unverified.
title: Sharp stochastic-increase Spearman ceiling and unique global optimizer for an exponentiated FGM copula
